title: Handling of DNN based congestion control

entities.name: DNN based congestion control
entities.description: Network procedure for detecting and performing congestion control based on DNN criteria as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: 5GS session management timer for DNN based congestion control, started and stopped on per DNN basis with special rules for LADN DNN and SNPN scenarios.

entities.name: DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name identifier provided by UE during PDU session establishment, used for congestion control association.

entities.name: LADN DNN
entities.description: Local Area Data Network DNN with special timer handling applied to registered PLMN and equivalent PLMNs.

entities.name: SNPN
entities.description: Standalone Non-Public Network identifier used for timer association in DNN congestion control.

entities.name: DNN congestion criteria met
entities.description: Condition when network detects one or more DNN congestion criteria as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 are met.

entities.name: T3396 running or deactivated
entities.description: Condition when timer T3396 is either running or deactivated, restricting UE from initiating certain procedures.

entities.name: Procedure restriction
entities.description: UE is not allowed to initiate PDU session establishment, PDU session modification, or NAS transport for CIoT user data when T3396 is running/deactivated for respective DNN.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session exception
entities.description: Timer T3396 associated with no DNN does not affect UE ability to request emergency PDU sessions.

relations.description: Network starts DNN based congestion control when DNN congestion criteria are met.
Network congestion control triggers starting of timer T3396 on per DNN basis.
Timer T3396 is associated with the DNN provided by UE during PDU session establishment.
For LADN DNN, timer T3396 is applied to registered PLMN and equivalent PLMNs.
For SNPN, timer T3396 association depends on UE support for credentials holder access.
When T3396 is running or deactivated, UE is restricted from initiating certain procedures.
Timer T3396 associated with no DNN does not restrict emergency PDU session requests.
